title: FROST MAGE

source.author: Mobalytics-Oli
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Mage Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Kite and slow with Frost: Frostbolt, Ice Lance and Frost Nova for one target, Blizzard for packs.

build.early: Arcane and Fire can level too but are less effective solo. At level 30 take Fingers of Frost, which gives your slows a chance to make the next spell treat the target as frozen.

why.Frostbite: Frostbolt can freeze; with Improved Blizzard you can freeze several enemies.
why.Ice Shards: Crit damage that powers later talents.
why.Piercing Ice: +6% Frost damage on your main spells.
why.Improved Blizzard: 15% slow for 1.5s, great for AoE kiting.
why.Fingers of Frost: Level 30: slows can set up Ice Lance.

core.t: Main filler: cast it often to slow and fish for Fingers of Frost.
Use on a frozen target (Frost Nova or Frostbite) or on a Fingers of Frost proc.
Root enemies in range, then back up and keep kiting.
Bread-and-butter AoE; slows while it damages.
Mainly buys time to back away.

items.t: when the target gets in range
on frozen or Fingers of Frost

notes: Keep Arcane Intellect and Frost Armor (or Ice Armor) up at all times; swap to Mage Armor in dungeons when you are not tanking.
Downrank Blizzard, Frost Nova and Cone of Cold to save mana: you use them for the slow, not the damage.
Skip spells that Frost does not use, like Scorch, to save gold. Visit the trainer for higher ranks of your damage spells.
Keep Light Feathers and buy reagents such as Rune of Teleportation. Stock mana potions and conjured mana gems for longer uptime.
Buff passing players with Arcane Intellect: it costs you little and may be returned.

stats.t: More damage; highly valuable when leveling a pure caster.
Spell crit and a bigger mana pool: extremely important for a Mage.
Regenerates mana and health so you rest less.

gear: Use a wand while enemies are slowed to conserve mana.
Stack Intellect and Spell Power; Spirit helps you rest less.
dungeon_tips: Frost Mages bring excellent single-target and area damage and can slow mobs to a crawl.
Your food, water and Arcane Intellect are valued by the whole party.
Polymorph buys time; Frost Nova works too but frozen enemies attack their nearest target.
Swap to Mage Armor instead of Ice or Frost Armor: you should not be tanking.

alliance.note: Expansive Mind (+5% mana) and Eureka! (cheaper, stronger next 3 casts); Escape Artist is a PvP bonus.

horde.note: Slight edge: Beast Slaying, Regeneration, Rapid Regeneration (pairs with Ice Block) and Berserking cast speed.

races.pick: Gnome for the Alliance, Troll for the Horde.

trainers: Visit your Mage trainer for higher ranks of your key damage spells.
